bibliographic.title: Power, MT
bibliographic.author: Phil Strahl
bibliographic.description:
Your rental broke down somewhere in Montana and you're stranded in the little town of Power. A local farmer, Mr. Davidson, offers you a place to stay over the night when things suddenly turn to the worse.

In the middle of the night you just want to stay alive, with the aid of your trusty cellohone clutched in your sweaty hands as a suffocating darkness falls on Power…

(Winner in the Mood category of Ludum Dare 39)

-- Author notes:--
Please play with the sound on because there is music.

This is my very first text adventure, written with Twine in SugarCube 2. You can use the roll-out menu (icon on the top-left) to save your game or go back any number of turns without penalty.

I am not even sure whether there are real puzzles to be solved, the main objective is not draining your battery completely. I tried my best to create a drmataic arch for the whole thing, but it's rather short.

The game was created in 48 hrs for the Ludum Dare #39 game-jam and due to that fact the "puzzles" probably are a bit arbitrary.
